teaser.en: Its round fruits grow as big as a cannonball, then crack apart into a puzzle of wedge-shaped seeds that the tide carries away.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake ya mviringo hukua makubwa kama gunduli la mzinga, kisha hupasuka na kuwa mbegu zenye umbo la kabari zinazoshikamana kama fumbo, nazo huchukuliwa na maji ya bahari.
teaser.dg: Matundage ga mviringo ganakula hadi kukala makulu dza mpira wa mzinga, chisha ganaahuka na kukala tembe zenye pembe zirizobanana dza vipande vya fumbo, na madzi ga bahari ganazitsukula.

summary.en: The cannonball mangrove is an evergreen tree of the landward mangrove edge, named for its huge, heavy round fruits. Its fine timber has long gone into beds, doors and window frames on the coast, which is one reason it has become scarce.
summary.sw: Mkomafi ni mti usiopukutisha majani unaoota ukingoni mwa mikoko upande wa nchi kavu, na umepata jina lake la Kiingereza kutokana na matunda yake makubwa, mazito na ya mviringo. Mbao zake bora zimetumika kwa muda mrefu pwani kutengenezea vitanda, milango na fremu za madirisha, na hiyo ni sababu mojawapo ya kuadimika kwake.
summary.dg: *Cannonball mangrove* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa kanda ya bara ya mikoko, na dzinare ra Chingereza rinalavywa kula matundage makulu, maziho na ga mviringo. Kula kare mbaoze nono zinahumirwa pwani kuhenda vitanda, miryango na vizingiti vya madirisha, na ihi ni sababu mwenga iriyohenda ukale adimu.

about.en:
The cannonball mangrove is an evergreen tree that grows to about 10 metres. Instead of stilt roots or pencil-like breathing roots, it spreads flattened, snake-like roots across the surface of the mud, winding away from the trunk like ribbons. The leaves are compound, with a few pairs of glossy, rounded leaflets, as is typical of the mahogany family it belongs to.

The fruit gives the tree its name. It is a hard, round ball that can reach 25 centimetres across, heavy enough to leave a dent where it falls. When ripe it splits open into a set of angular, wedge-shaped seeds that fit together like the pieces of a puzzle. The seeds float, and many are carried off by the tide to settle on new mud.
about.sw:
Mkomafi ni mti usiopukutisha majani unaofikia urefu wa takriban mita 10. Badala ya mizizi-mihimili au mizizi ya kupumulia iliyochongoka kama penseli, hutandaza mizizi bapa inayofanana na nyoka juu ya tope, ikijipinda mbali na shina kama riboni. Majani yake ni mchanganyiko, yakiwa na jozi chache za vijani vinavyong'aa na vya mviringo, kama ilivyo kawaida kwa familia ya mkangazi (mahogany) ambayo mti huu ni sehemu yake.

Tunda ndilo lililoupa mti jina lake la Kiingereza. Ni mpira mgumu wa mviringo unaoweza kufikia upana wa sentimita 25, mzito kiasi cha kuacha shimo pale unapoangukia. Likiiva hupasuka na kuwa kundi la mbegu zenye pembe na umbo la kabari zinazoshikamana kama vipande vya fumbo. Mbegu hizo huelea, na nyingi huchukuliwa na maji kupwa na kujaa hadi kutua kwenye tope jipya.
about.dg:
*Cannonball mangrove* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati unaokula hadi phephi mita 10. Badala ya mizi iriyootyoka au mizi dza kalamu ya kuphahira pumuzi, miziye mibapa, dza nyoka, inaenea dzulu ya matope, ichizunguluka kula kpwa kolo dza vitambaa vyembamba. Makodzage ni ga kuungana: chila kodza rina makodza madide machache, airi-airi, ganaala na ni ga mviringo, dza irivyo kawaida kpwa jamiiye, jamii ya *mahogany*.

Tunda ndiro rinaropha muhi uhu dzinare. Ni mpira mgumu wa mviringo unaoweza kufika sentimita 25 kpwa upana, na ni mziho hata unaricha alama photsi phatu unaphogbwa. Richiivwa rinaahuka na kukala tembe zenye pembe, zirizobanana phamwenga dza vipande vya fumbo. Tembe zinaelea, na nyinji nkutsukulwa ni madzi ga bahari hadi kpwenye matope maphya, ambako zinamera.

where.en: Look for it near the high-water mark on the landward side of the mangrove, where the mud is firmer and only the highest tides reach. It is not a common tree: in the Vanga mangroves it makes up only a small share of the forest. Fallen fruits and loose seeds on the mud are often the easiest clue that one is nearby, and the surface roots are best seen at low tide.
where.sw: Utaupata karibu na alama ya maji makuu upande wa nchi kavu wa mikoko, ambapo tope ni gumu zaidi na ni maji makuu tu yanayofika. Si mti wa kawaida: katika mikoko ya Vanga ni sehemu ndogo tu ya msitu. Matunda yaliyoanguka na mbegu zilizotawanyika juu ya tope mara nyingi ndiyo dalili rahisi kwamba mti huu uko karibu, na mizizi yake ya juu huonekana vizuri zaidi wakati wa maji kupwa.
where.dg: Uhendze phephi na phatu madzi ga kuodzala ganaphofika, uphande wa bara wa mikoko, ambapho matope ni magumu zaidi na ni madzi makulu sana ga kuodzala tu ganayofika. Si muhi wa kawaida: kpwenye mikoko ya Vanga ni seemu ndide tu ya tsaka. Matunda ganayogbwa na tembe zirizolala dzulu ya matope kpwa kawaida ndizo alama rahisi zaidi kukala muhi uhu u phephi, na mizi ya dzulu ya matope inaonekana vinono zaidi wakati wa madzi ga kala.

uses.en:
The wood is among the best that the mangroves offer. It is valued as high-quality timber for beds and for door and window frames, and it also burns well as firewood and charcoal. Because good trees are taken selectively for timber, the larger specimens have become hard to find.

The fruit has a use of its own: it is crushed and made into ointments.
uses.sw:
Mbao zake ni miongoni mwa bora kabisa zinazopatikana mikokoni. Zinathaminiwa kama mbao za hadhi ya juu za kutengenezea vitanda na fremu za milango na madirisha, na pia huwaka vizuri zikitumika kama kuni na mkaa. Kwa sababu miti mizuri hukatwa kwa kuchaguliwa kwa ajili ya mbao, miti mikubwa imekuwa vigumu kupatikana.

Tunda nalo lina matumizi yake: hupondwa na kutengenezwa marhamu.
uses.dg:
Mbaoze ni kahi ya mbao bora sana zinazolavywa ni mikoko. Zina samani kpwa sababu ni mbao nono za kuhendera vitanda na vizingiti vya miryango na madirisha, na piya zinaaka vinono dza kuni na makala. Kpwa sababu mihi minono nkutsambulwa na kukatwa kpwa mbao, mihi mikulu ikakala vigumu kuiphaha.

Tunda piya rina kaziye: nkusirwa na kuhendwa mafuha ga kupaka.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili it is *mkomafi* or *mtonga*; *mkomafi* is also used for its close relative, the cedar mangrove. In English it is the cannonball mangrove, and botanists know it as *Xylocarpus granatum*. The species name *granatum* compares the fruit to a pomegranate.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mkomafi* au *mtonga*; jina *mkomafi* hutumika pia kwa ndugu yake wa karibu, *mkomafi* mdogo (*cedar mangrove*). Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *cannonball mangrove*, na wataalamu wa mimea wanaujua kama *Xylocarpus granatum*. Jina la spishi *granatum* linalinganisha tunda lake na komamanga.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo taridzangbweandikpwa. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkomafi* au *mtonga*; *mkomafi* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa nduguye wa phephi, *cedar mangrove*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *cannonball mangrove*, na asayansi a mimea anaumanya kukala *Xylocarpus granatum*. Dzina ra aina, *granatum*, rinagomba kukala tunda rinahalana na *komamanga* (*pomegranate*).

conservation.en: The tree is scarce on the south coast and is selectively cut for its timber. It is globally Least Concern, but Kenya's mangroves are heavily cut for poles and fuel, so harvesting is licensed by the Kenya Forest Service, and community projects at Gazi and Makongeni (Mikoko Pamoja) and at Vanga, Jimbo and Kiwegu (Vanga Blue Forest) are restoring the forest.
conservation.sw: Mti huu ni adimu katika pwani ya kusini na hukatwa kwa kuchaguliwa kwa ajili ya mbao zake. Kimataifa uko katika hali ya Wasiwasi Mdogo (Least Concern), lakini mikoko ya Kenya hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya boriti na nishati, kwa hiyo uvunaji hupewa leseni na Shirika la Misitu la Kenya (Kenya Forest Service), na miradi ya kijamii huko Gazi na Makongeni (Mikoko Pamoja) na huko Vanga, Jimbo na Kiwegu (Vanga Blue Forest) inarejesha msitu.
conservation.dg: Muhi uhu ni adimu pwani ya kusini, na nkukatwa kpwa kutsambulwa kpwa sababu ya mbaoze. Duniani tauri hatarini, ela mikoko ya Kenya inakatwa sana kpwa nguzo na kuni, kpwa hivyo kuikata kunahitaji leseni ya Kenya Forest Service, na mipango ya jamii ya Gazi na Makongeni (Mikoko Pamoja) na ya Vanga, Jimbo na Kiwegu (Vanga Blue Forest) inauyiza tsaka.
